name: Lesson 2 · First air
intro: Speed, then the lip. Hold jump to load, release as you hit the lip.

goals.hint: Pump for speed, hold Space (A) while steering up the face, release at the lip
In the air, hold K (B) with a stick direction for a grab. Let go before you land
Land square to the wave: inside 20° is Perfect, past 45° is a wipeout
